plan.title: Single-stage delete one of two product rows

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Create two product-sheet rows using the mapped CYLINDER product.
Assert that the sheet contains the two required rows before deletion.
Enter the requested quantity for the first row.
Confirm the first row retained quantity 10.
Choose the specified delivery location for the first row.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Capture the automatic title before removing a row.
Use the closest available line-item deletion flow to remove one of the two rows.
Assert that exactly one row remains after deletion.
